verdicts.reason: A: the crowd illustration is pushed against the left canvas edge and runs straight into 'NEVER/COMMITTED/IT'S' with no gutter, so the quote collides with the figures. The quote also fills the full height with almost no top or bottom margin, and the red attribution is tiny and left floating in the empty right side. B: the crowd keeps a left margin and has a clear gutter before the quote, so the left-to-right reading order works. It still has flaws: the quote is jammed against the top and bottom edges, the attribution is small, and the right third is mostly dead space.
